digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Tracker re-clone without preserving git-ignored .env-id silently mints a new environment identity, rendering all prior attestations unverifiable without warning or detection.

Minting .env-id into a store with existing events from another environment must warn loudly on stderr, naming the prior env-id(s), the attestation consequence, required carry-over files, and an explicit override mechanism.

rebar fsck must emit a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH check scoped by author (detecting when the current environment's own author also wrote events under a different env-id) to surface re-clone identity divergence store-wide.
Multi-clone topology with distinct authors and separate environment identities must not trigger false-positive divergence detection, as each clone legitimately needs its own identity.

Environment identity re-minting must always complete (to support shared tickets branches), but proceeding without override acknowledgment when a store holds another environment's events must emit a non-silent warning.
